summary: Iteration-5 backend tests (Tanggal Terima receive endpoint + REPORT AR Excel export + Invoice Excel export + signer setting integration). 15 new tests authored in test_iteration4_receive_exports.py, all PASS. Iteration-3 regression suite (19 tests) also re-run and PASS — 34/34 total.

minor.issue: Endpoint requires `key_name` in BOTH path param AND request body (uses SettingIn model). This is redundant and confusing — the body's key_name is never used (server overwrites with path value). Recommend either dropping `key_name` from SettingIn or creating a dedicated SettingValueIn(BaseModel) {key_value: str}. Current behaviour returns 422 if body omits key_name.

Date filter uses `created_at` (=order pickup_date) for the month bucket. Note: 'Tanggal Terima' column comes from `received_at`. So an AWB picked up 2026-05-30 and received 2026-06-02 will appear under May, not June, in the month=2026-06 export. Confirm with product whether the month should filter by pickup or receive date.

All exceptions inside the per-invoice loop are swallowed with a bare `except Exception: continue` — including programming errors. If 0 of N invoice IDs are valid the response is 400 'Tidak ada invoice valid' (good), but otherwise silent failures are hidden. Consider logging skipped IDs with reason, similar to /api/invoices/bulk.

test_results_detail.TestReceiveEndpoint: 4/4 PASS — full payload persists (op/fin/admin); spsi/forklift disabled → amounts forced to 0; invalid date → 400; bogus order id → 404. Confirmed received_by_name is .strip()'d (leading/trailing spaces removed).
test_results_detail.TestReportArExport: 5/5 PASS — workbook returns sheet 'REPORT AR' with Content-Disposition containing 'REPORT_AR_'. Row 1 main cols (1-17) match spec verbatim. Merged group headers at col 18/27/36 hold 'Kirim Barang'/'Dismantle Barang'/'Relokasi Barang'. Row 2 sub-headers match per group (Polis/Insurance/SPSI/Sewa Froklift + per-group middle cols + Air/Konsul/Trucking). Trailing cols 45-50 = Amount(Exc VAT)/Keterangan/Harga/List Muatan/Asuransi/No Invoice. month=2026-06 filter returns only JUN rows. month=bad → 400. Created live AWB w/ Kirim+Trucking: Polis@col18, Insurance@col19=333000, SPSI@col20=123000, Sewa Froklift@col21 empty (disabled), Trucking@col26=grand_total, Air@col24 + Konsul@col25 empty. Dismantle+Air row: Polis@col27, Insurance@col28=444000, Air@col33=grand_total, all Kirim/Relokasi cols empty.
test_results_detail.TestInvoiceExport: 4/4 PASS — single export returns xlsx with sheet = invoice_number[-31:], B6='INVOICE', B8=company_name, R8=invoice_number, C13=consignee (Attn). Bulk export with 2 valid invoice IDs returns >=2 sheets. Bulk with 1 valid + 2 bogus IDs returns 1 sheet (invalid silently skipped). Bulk with empty list returns 400.
test_results_detail.TestSettingsAndSigner: 2/2 PASS — All 6 seeded keys (signer_/address_/npwp_ × Pradana/Pratama) present in GET /api/settings. After PUT signer_PT. Abirama Mitra Pradana = 'TEST JOHN DOE XXXX', a newly-created invoice for that company contains the signer string in its workbook (signature row).

action_items: (MINOR) Clean up PUT /api/settings/{key_name} to not require redundant key_name in body — currently breaks any client that only sends key_value.

(QUESTION for product) Confirm REPORT AR month filter semantics: filter is on pickup date (created_at), not on Tanggal Terima (received_at). If users expect month=delivery-month, switch filter to received_at.
(POLISH) /api/exports/invoices/bulk silently swallows ALL exceptions per-invoice. Consider returning JSON {skipped: [...]} for bigger files OR at least log the skipped ids and reasons server-side.
critical_code_review_comments: ReceiveAwbIn / receive_awb endpoint correctly enforces spsi_amount=0 when spsi_enabled=False (and same for forklift) — server overrides any client-supplied value. Good defensive coding.

_build_invoice_sheet pulls signer per-company via settings['signer_' + company_name] with no fallback to a generic signer — verified working. Should the company_name not match a seeded key, signer renders as '...........................' which is acceptable.

REPORT AR merge-cell layout is correct: merged rows 1-2 for main cols (1-17 + 45-50), row 1 merged across each group (18-26, 27-35, 36-44). Group placement logic (work_type.lower() containing 'kirim'/'dismantle'/'relokasi') is forgiving but correct.

PUT /api/settings/{key_name} uses SettingIn (which requires key_name in body) — the path param's key_name is what actually gets persisted. Either drop key_name from SettingIn or accept just {key_value}. Test had to send both.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed AWBs (~10) during the run via /api/orders, plus matching invoices and a cost per invoiced AWB. Receive endpoint exercised on ~7 of them. No cleanup performed (test data is lightweight and prefixed with TEST_ for easy identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-4 feature surface (Tanggal Terima receive + REPORT AR + Invoice Excel + per-issuer signer) is fully wired and verified end-to-end with openpyxl introspection of the generated workbooks. The only nuisance is PUT /api/settings/{key_name} demanding a redundant body.key_name — if you write new settings tests, send {key_name, key_value} together. The REPORT AR month filter is on pickup date not receive date — by design or bug, please confirm with product.
